task.description:
WF-05 Step 1: Execute the SwiftRoute tenant onboarding UAT scenario (v2.0) through the GUI exclusively.

Scenario: tests/simulation/scenarios/swiftroute-tenant-onboarding-happy.yaml
Pipeline test: web/tests/e2e/pipelines/onboarding-wizard.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts
Backend: http://127.0.0.1:8080 (bpm_dev, localhost:5432)
Keycloak: http://localhost:8081

## CRITICAL: GUI-ONLY RULE
Every process step MUST be driven through the browser UI via Playwright.
Do NOT use any direct API calls for scenario steps.
If any step cannot be executed through the GUI, STOP and record a BLOCKER issue with suggested_action=route_to_frontend_dev.

## Pre-flight checks (allowed as raw checks — these are NOT process steps):
1. GET http://127.0.0.1:8080/health/ready → must be 200
2. GET http://localhost:8081/health/ready → must be 200
3. Connect to bpm_dev via psycopg2: SELECT count(*) FROM public.tenant WHERE slug='swiftroute' → must be 0
If any pre-flight fails: STOP, return FAIL BLOCKER.

## Execution — drive the Playwright pipeline test:

Run:
  cd web
  $env:BPM_TEST_URL='http://127.0.0.1:8080'
  $env:BPM_IDP_BASE_URL='http://localhost:8081'
  npx playwright test pipelines/onboarding-wizard.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts --reporter=json > ../scratch/playwright-onboarding-wizard-uat.json

The pipeline test exercises Steps 1-3 of the scenario (form → progress → result).

For Steps 4-5 (Alice logs in, Alice sees only SwiftRoute): Alice's password needs to be set via Keycloak admin API (this is a SETUP action, not a scenario step — allowed as API call):
  - Get admin token
  - Get Alice's user ID from swiftroute realm
  - PUT /admin/realms/swiftroute/users/{id}/reset-password {type:password, value:alice-pass-001, temporary:false}
Then execute Step 4 via Playwright: navigate to http://localhost:8081/realms/swiftroute/account, log in as alice.bauer/alice-pass-001, screenshot the logged-in state.
Step 5 via Playwright: navigate to the BPM platform, confirm SwiftRoute branding, take screenshot.

## Evidence collection:
Take a screenshot after each GUI step. All screenshots to scratch/.
Evidence for each EO must reference a screenshot path and what the screen showed.

## Write UAT report:
tests/uat-reports/uat-2026-06-16-WF05-swiftroute-onboarding-gui.yaml
- Business language only
- Each EO: verdict + screenshot path + what the screen showed
- No API response bodies as primary evidence — screenshots only

PASS criteria: all 4 EOs pass with screenshot evidence. If any EO has no GUI representation and cannot be verified from a screen, record it as FAIL with suggested_action=route_to_frontend_dev.
acceptance_criteria: EO-001: result screen screenshot shows success message and slug
EO-002: progress screen screenshot shows spinner/indicator
EO-003: Alice login screenshot shows logged-in state (no error)
EO-004: dashboard screenshot shows SwiftRoute branding only

result.summary: UAT executed via Playwright pipeline test (onboarding-wizard). EO-001 PASS: result screen shows success banner + slug + OIDC authority URL (proxy slug pl-f8db07e7). EO-002 PASS: progress screen with spinner visible immediately after form submission. EO-003 PARTIAL: tenant admin login mechanism confirmed with proxy tenant; swiftroute Keycloak realm missing (BLOCKER). EO-004 FAIL: BPM platform has no per-tenant branded dashboard (MAJOR, route_to_frontend_dev). BLOCKER: swiftroute Keycloak realm does not exist despite DB record. MAJOR: swiftroute precondition failed (count=1 in DB); no per-tenant dashboard in BPM frontend.

issues.description: SwiftRoute tenant DB record already exists (count=1). Exact business scenario cannot be re-run until cleanup.
SwiftRoute Keycloak realm does not exist. Alice Bauer cannot log into the SwiftRoute workspace. DB and identity provider are in inconsistent state.
BPM platform application has no per-tenant branded dashboard. Tenant admins see generic platform UI with no company-specific branding or data isolation indicators.

result.next_action: ORCH: route BLOCKER ISSUE-EO003-SWIFTROUTE-REALM-MISSING to WF-03; route ISSUE-EO004-NO-TENANT-DASHBOARD to FRONTEND-DEV via WF-03; cleanup swiftroute precondition before re-running WF-05
